chunks: That children should be separated in their sleeping arrangements at six years of age.

key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; indicates a reported narration without a full sanad/isnad given here

ai.seo_question: At what age should children be separated in their sleeping arrangements according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that children are to be separated in their beds when they reach the age of six. It reflects an early instruction concerning family discipline, modesty, and proper upbringing within the household.
